svg.title: Landtman: ranking among the Kiwai Papuans
svg.desc: Three stacked bands, each set slightly lower than the one above. Top: a little more high, warriors, harpooners, and sorcerers. Middle: most villagers, who did the same work and lived in similar housing. Bottom: down a little bit, women, the unemployed, and the unmarried, who were barred from owning land.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
